title: Indirect questions (Do you know where…? Could you tell me…?)
en:
Indirect questions are more polite. They start with Do you know…? Could you tell me…? I'd like to know… I wonder…

After the beginning, use normal word order (subject + verb), no do / does / did: Where is the office? → Do you know where the office is? What time does it start? → Could you tell me what time it starts?

Yes / no questions → if / whether: Is he in? → Do you know if he is in?

Very useful at interviews: Could you tell me what the next steps are?
ru: Вежливые вопросы: Do you know…? Could you tell me…? Дальше — прямой порядок слов (подлежащее + глагол), без do/does/did: Could you tell me where the office is? Вопрос да/нет → if: Do you know if he is in?

boss.situation: At the end of an interview, ask 5 polite indirect questions about the job and the company.
samples: Could you tell me what a typical day looks like?
Do you know when the team was created?
I'd like to know how performance is measured.
Could you tell me if there is a training programme?
Do you know when I will hear from you?

qs.q: I'd like to know ___ the job includes travel.
Can you tell me how much ___?
“Do you know where does he work?” is correct.
qs.exp: No does: Do you know where he works?

qs.q: “Could you tell me what the next steps are?” is correct.
Do you know when the auditors ___ (arrive)? — Next Monday.
a: are arriving
will arrive
arrive

qs.q: Could you tell me ___ the director is in his office?
a: if
whether

qs.q: I wonder why she ___ (leave) so early yesterday.
a: left
qs.exp: Past, no did: why she left.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: do you know where the archive is

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: could you tell me what the salary is

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i would like to know if there is a training programme

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Could you tell me where is the meeting room?”
a: Could you tell me where the meeting room is?

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Do you know what time does the bank open?”
a: Do you know what time the bank opens?

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Can you tell me did he call?”
a: Can you tell me if he called?
Can you tell me whether he called?

qs.q: Не подскажете, где находится отдел кадров?
a: Could you tell me where the HR department is?
Do you know where the HR department is?
Could you tell me where HR is?
Can you tell me where the HR department is?

qs.q: Вы не знаете, во сколько начинается собеседование?
a: Do you know what time the interview starts?
Do you know when the interview starts?
Do you know what time the interview begins?
Could you tell me what the next steps are?
Can you tell me what the next steps are?
May I ask what the next steps are?
I'd like to know what the next steps are.
